About this space
Surrounded by a beautiful garden, this modern self contained guesthouse offers the perfect balance of comfort, tranquility and relaxation.

Whether you are on a business trip , weekend away or long term stay, the space has been carefully curated to feel like your second home.

Amenities
Solar power for uninterrupted power supply
Back up water supply on site
Automated gate ( shared access)
Smart TV with DSTV

5 min drive to nearest grocery store.
12 min drive to CBD.
